items.title: FTC is investigating OpenAI, Anthropic and other AI companies over product risks
items.blurb: The probe adds to the mounting scrutiny that OpenAI and Anthropic have been facing over their safety practices following the Hugging Face hack.

items.title: The AI Race Just Got Awkward
Gemini 4 Argon
items.blurb: Announcing Gemini 4 Argon, our frontier model for real-world coding, enterprise knowledge work, and cyber defense, rolling out soon.

items.title: TypeSafe AI Releases Jev: A Decision-Only Model That Returns Typed Probabilities Instead of Text
items.blurb: TypeSafe AI, founded by former OpenAI researcher Diogo Almeida, has introduced Jev, a decision-making model that generates typed outputs rather than text.

items.title: outis: Fight AI spam by generating and sending a fake "user unknown" bounce emails
items.blurb: Outis fights spam generating and sends a fake "user unknown" bounce for an email you received, so the sender believes your address does not exist.

items.title: InfoQ Online Cohorts Address AI Security and Coding Agent Verification
items.blurb: A look at two InfoQ online certification cohorts covering security and privacy decisions in production AI systems and the verification needed when coding agents work in existing codebases. By Artenisa Chatziou

items.title: Presentation: Beyond Observability: Evolving Production Operations in the Age of AI
items.blurb: The panelists discuss how production operations are evolving with AI, turning operational data into actionable insights for incident response.

items.title: How to Develop Software Engineering Skills in the Age of AI
items.blurb: Software engineering skill development requires slowing down. Generative AI has changed the landscape of skill development for software engineering. Tools and AI can accelerate outcomes, but they may not support skill development.

items.title: Presentation: Keeping the Mainline Green Across Diverse Language Monorepos
items.blurb: Dhruva Juloori discusses how Uber maintains green mainlines across massive monorepos handling 65,000+ monthly changes.
